=== Europe ===

====Balkans====
Turkish TV shows are widely successful all over the Balkan Region. Serbian sociologist [[Ratko Božović]] explains this popularity by pointing to the traditional, patriarchal values of the Turkish shows, and the many cultural and linguistic similarities between Turkey and the Balkan countries: "The mentality depicted in those shows has to do with a traditional understanding of morality that people in the Balkans remember at some level". According to him, all Balkan countries have seen dramatic changes in terms of family life, and the Turkish shows help them recall value systems that now seem lost.<ref name="Balkan Insights">{{cite web|title=Turks bewitch the Balkans with their addictive tv soaps|date=May 2013|url=http://www.balkaninsight.com/en/article/turks-bewitch-the-balkans-with-their-addictive-soaps|access-date=2013-05-03|publisher=Balkan Insights}}</ref>

The most watched show in [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]] was ''[[Muhteşem Yüzyıl]]''. In [[Kosovo]], the most popular TV shows in December 2012 were ''[[Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne?]]'', which ranked top of all programmes and ''[[Aşk ve Ceza]]'', which came in third according to data by [[Index Kosova]]. A study found that the two most popular Turkish TV shows in Serbia in January 2013 were ''Muhteşem Yüzyıl'', which ranked fourth, and ''[[Öyle Bir Geçer Zaman Ki]]'' (''As Time Goes By''), which ranked seventh. In [[North Macedonia]], ''Öyle Bir Geçer Zaman ki'' and ''[[Asi (TV series)|Asi]]'' were the top two shows in terms of viewers in January 2013, according to [[Nielsen Media Research]].<ref name="Balkan Insights" /> In fact, Turkish shows are so successful in North Macedonia that the government has passed a bill to restrict broadcasts of Turkish series during the day and at prime time to reduce the Turkish impact on North Macedonia's society.<ref>{{cite web|title=Macedonia bans Turkish tv series| date=15 November 2012 |url=http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/macedonia-bans-turkish-soap-operas.aspx?pageID=238&nid=34636|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131020213014/http://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/macedonia-bans-turkish-soap-operas.aspx?pageID=238&nid=34636|archive-date=2013-10-20|access-date=2013-01-15|publisher=Hurriyet Daily News}}</ref>{{better source needed|date=March 2026}}

They are also widely watched by [[Bulgaria]]n viewers.<ref>{{cite web|title=New Turkish Slavery?|url=http://christopherbuxton.com/index.php/writing/journalism/new-turkish-slavery/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120123232637/http://christopherbuxton.com/index.php/writing/journalism/new-turkish-slavery|archive-date=2012-01-23|access-date=2013-01-15|publisher=Christopher Buxton}}</ref> [[Nova (Bulgarian TV channel)|Nova Televizia]] broke the record for viewer numbers when it started broadcasting the Turkish TV series ''[[Binbir Gece]]''. The channel then decided to broadcast another Turkish show, ''[[Dudaktan Kalbe]]''.<ref>{{cite web|title=Turkish soap operas take Bulgaria by storm| date=13 June 2009 |url=http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/english/domestic/11855675.asp?scr=1|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140225014951/http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/english/domestic/11855675.asp?scr=1|archive-date=2014-02-25|publisher=Hürriyet Daily News}}</ref>

''Binbir Gece''  became a primetime hit in Bosnia, Montenegro and North Macedonia, as well as in Romania, Albania and Greece.<ref name="obg">{{cite web|title=Soap power: The sweeping success of Turkish television series|date=20 June 2012|url=http://www.oxfordbusinessgroup.com/news/soap-power-sweeping-success-turkish-television-series|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141013171306/http://www.oxfordbusinessgroup.com/news/soap-power-sweeping-success-turkish-television-series|archive-date=2014-10-13|publisher=Oxford Business Group}}</ref> 
It has increased the popularity of Istanbul as a tourist destination among [[Croatia]]ns, and led to a greater interest in learning Turkish.<ref>{{cite web|date=2010-09-30|title=Retailers cashing in on Croatia´s obsession with Turkish soap|url=http://www.croatiantimes.com/news/Panorama/2010-09-30/14105/Retailers_cashing_in_on_Croatia%B4s_obsession_with_Turkish_soap|publisher=Croatian Times|access-date=2013-01-15|archive-date=2010-10-04|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101004163624/http://www.croatiantimes.com/news/Panorama/2010-09-30/14105/Retailers_cashing_in_on_Croatia%B4s_obsession_with_Turkish_soap|url-status=dead}}</ref>

====Slovakia====
In [[Slovakia]], the popularity of Turkish series has improved the public image of Turkey itself.<ref>{{cite web|title=Turkish "Soap" Power...|url=http://www.usak.org.tr/EN/myazdir.asp?id=2297|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130418234111/http://www.usak.org.tr/EN/myazdir.asp?id=2297|archive-date=2013-04-18|publisher=International Strategic Research Organization}}</ref>

==== Greece ====
Turkish TV series were also popular in [[Greece]] until their widespread removal from Greek TV in 2020 due to Turkish incursions into Greek [[Aegean dispute|territorial waters]].<ref>{{cite web|date=2020-07-22|title=Απόφαση σταθμός: Τέλος, προς το παρόν, τα τούρκικα σίριαλ στην ελληνική τηλεόραση!|url=https://www.athensmagazine.gr/article/tv/470664-apofash-stathmos-telos-ta-toyrkika-sirial-sthn-ellhnikh-thleorash|access-date=2021-05-19|website=Athens magazine|language=el}}</ref><ref name="The International" /> After 2019, due to the resurgence of Greek language programming, Turkish series have largely disappeared from Greek television. The Greek Orthodox Bishop Anthimos criticised Greek fans of Turkish TV series<ref>{{cite news|date=2012-10-30|title=Bishop Anthimos Lashes Turkish tv series Fans|newspaper=Greekreporter.com |url=http://greece.greekreporter.com/2012/10/30/bishop-anthimos-hits-out-at-turkish-soap-fans/|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130123190415/http://greece.greekreporter.com/2012/10/30/bishop-anthimos-hits-out-at-turkish-soap-fans/|archive-date=2013-01-23|access-date=2013-01-15|publisher=Greek Reporter|last1=Makris |first1=A. }}</ref> after ''[[Yabancı Damat]]'' (''The Foreign Groom'') was one of the first Turkish series to become popular in Greece in 2005.<ref>{{cite web|title=Daze of Our Lives|url=http://www.odyssey.gr/artsLiving/articles~54~daze~article|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140222055515/http://www.odyssey.gr/artsLiving/articles~54~daze~article|archive-date=2014-02-22|access-date=2013-01-15|publisher=Odyssey.gr}}</ref>

''[[Yabancı Damat]]'' started airing in Greece on 11 July 2005, recording a viewing rate of 31.7%; the last episode aired on 5 July 2008, recording a viewing rate of 31.8%. ''Binbir Gece'' started being shown in June 2010, by ANT1, recording a viewership rate of 18.7%. The last episode aired on 1 February 2011, scoring 24.3%, while the highest percentage was 43.8% on 6 August 2010. Another popular drama was ''Sıla''; it aired in Greece on 10 June 2012, on MEGA. The series ''Elif'' had a particularly significant average viewership share: 16.8% of all viewers; it was watched daily by an average of about 450,000 viewers.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.protothema.gr/life-style/article/1032436/o-hartis-tis-ellinotourkikis-tileoptikis-ufalokripidas/ | title=Τουρκικές σειρές: Ο χάρτης της ελληνοτουρκικής τηλεοπτικής... υφαλοκρηπίδας | date=5 August 2020 }}</ref>

Recently, Greek television channels have started broadcasting their own adaptations of Turkish TV shows.<ref>{{cite news |title=Yargı'nın Yunanistan uyarlaması Eylül ayında ekranda! |url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/48109/1/yarginin-yunanistan-uyarlamasi-eylul-ayinda-ekranda |newspaper=Ranini.tv |access-date=26 March 2026 |date=7 July 2022}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/48086/1/kirmizi-odanin-yunanistan-uyarlamasi-storginin-tanitimi-yayinlandi | title=Kırmızı Oda'nın Yunanistan uyarlaması Storgi'nin tanıtımı yayınlandı! | newspaper=Ranini.tv  | access-date=26 March 2026 | date=4 July 2022}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dizidoktoru.com/dizi/bir-zamanlar-cukurovanin-yunanistan-uyarlamasi-reyting-rekorlari-h32936.html|title=Bir Zamanlar Çukurova'nın Yunanistan uyarlaması reyting rekorları kırıyor|website=www.dizidoktoru.com|accessdate=29 May 2023|date=23 March 2023}}</ref>

==== Romania ====
The series ''[[Ezel (TV series)|Ezel]]'' was adapted by Romanian TV channel [[Pro TV]] under the title ''Vlad''.<ref>[https://www.paginademedia.ro/2019/02/audiente-tv-serialul-vlad-primul-episod AUDIENȚE TV. Câți români au văzut primul episod din ''Vlad''? Pro TV, cu peste jumătate de milion mai mult decât Antena 1], Pagina de Media, 26.02.2019</ref> ''[[O Hayat Benim]]'' was remade by Calinos Entertainment as ''Adela'' in 2020.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/42290/1/o-hayat-benim-dizisi-romanyada-uyarlaniyor|title = O Hayat Benim dizisi Romanya'da uyarlanıyor!| newspaper=Ranini.tv }}</ref> {{lang|ro|Fructul oprit}}, a Romanian adaptation of ''Aşk-ı Memnu'', was also produced by [[Antena 1 (Romania)|Antena 1]] in 2018.<ref>{{cite web|date=21 March 2019|title='Aşk-ı Memnu' senaristlerinden Romanya'ya dava|url=http://www.milliyet.com.tr/cadde/ask-i-memnu-senaristlerinden-romanyaya-dava-2846173|newspaper=Milliyet}}</ref> ''[[İçerde]]'' was remade as ''The Clan'' ({{lang|ro|Clanul}}) and aired on Pro TV starting August 2022.<ref>{{cite news | url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/52992/1/icerdenin-romanya-uyarlamasi-the-clana-uzanti-dizi-de-geliyor-our-f | title=İçerde'nin Romanya uyarlaması The Clan'a uzantı dizi de geliyor: Our Father | newspaper = Ranini.tv | accessdate = 27 March 2026 | date = 27 June 2024}}</ref>

====Spain====
Following their success in Latin America, Turkish TV series have attracted significant interest in Spain. In 2018, Spanish channel [[Nova (Spanish TV channel)|Nova]] started showing ''[[Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne?]]'', which went on to become its most popular series. Building on this success, Nova began airing other Turkish series, including ''Kara Para Aşk'', ''Elif'', ''Ezel'', ''Sıla'', ''Medcezir'', ''Anne'', ''One Thousand and One Nights'', and ''[[Adını Feriha Koydum]]''. At the same time, Spanish broadcaster Atresmedia adapted ''Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne?'' as [[Alba (TV series)|''Alba'']].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://teammy.com/2021/02/16/19513/|title=Premiere of the Spanish remake of the Fatmagul series Alba|date=16 February 2021|website=Turkish Series: Teammy}}</ref>{{failed verification|date=March 2026}}

Other Turkish dramas that have received high ratings on different Spanish channels include ''Kadın'' (adapted into ''Mujer''), ''[[Sen Çal Kapımı]]'', ''[[Erkenci Kuş]]'', ''[[Kızım]]'', ''[[Bir Zamanlar Çukurova]]'' (adapted into ''Tierra Amarga'') and ''[[Sadakatsiz]]'' (adapted into ''Infiel'').<ref>{{cite web|url=https://televizyongazetesi.com/fatmagulun-sucu-ne-baslatti-kadin-ve-kizim-dizileri-ispanyayi-turk-dizisi-hayrani-yapti/169362|title=Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne başlattı, Kadın ve Kızım dizileri İspanya'yı Türk dizisi hayranı yaptı!|date=23 June 2021}}</ref> ''Kadın'' was the first Turkish series aired in prime time in Spain; it has managed to lead its time slot for a year, even facing great products and being broadcast for several days in a row.<ref name="elespanol.com"/> Sadakatsiz aired in Spain with an average audience of 2.3 million viewers, which makes it one of the foreign series with the best debut since 2020.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Mag |first1=Redacción |url=https://mag.elcomercio.pe/fama/infiel-volkan-cerca-de-perder-para-siempre-a-asya-sadakatsiz-telenovelas-turcas-nnda-nnlt-noticia/|title="Infiel": Volkan, cerca de perder para siempre a Asya|date=23 September 2021|website=mag.elcomercio}}
</ref> Caner Cindoruk was on the cover of Spain's "Albacete A Mano" magazine for the promotion of the TV series ''Sadakatsiz''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cnnturk.com/magazin/caner-cindoruk-dizideki-karakteri-volkan-hakkinda-konustu|title=Caner Cindoruk dizideki karakteri Volkan hakkında konuştu - Son Dakika Magazin Haberleri|date=1 October 2021|website=CNN TÜRK|accessdate=29 May 2023}}</ref>

While it was being produced by Turkish Netflix, the series, ''Eğer Bilseydim'', whose production was not made due to censorship, written by Ece Yörenç, will be broadcast by Spanish Netflix under the name of Si lo Hubiera Sabido.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.diken.com.tr/turkiyede-lgbti-karakter-nedeniyle-iptal-edilen-netflix-dizisi-ispanyol-yapimi-olarak-yayinlanacak/|title=Eşcinsel karakter nedeniyle iptal edilen Türk yapımı Netflix dizisi İspanyol yapımı olarak yayınlanacak|date=25 August 2021|newspaper=Diken - Yaramazlara Biraz Batar!}}</ref>

A Spanish remake of the Turkish drama ''[[Anne (Turkish TV series)|Anne]]'' (''Mother'') will air as ''Heridas'' on Antena 3.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.audiovisual451.com/heridas-la-adaptacion-de-mother-inicia-su-grabacion-para-atresmedia/|title='Heridas', la adaptación de 'Mother', inicia su grabación para Atresmedia|date=22 June 2021}}</ref> Another Spanish remake of Turkish drama ''[[Son (TV series)|Son]]'' aired as ''El Accidente'' on Telecinco in 2017.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.todotvnews.com/news/La-adaptacin-espaola-de-The-End-tiene-al-fin-fecha-de-estreno.html |title=La adaptación española de the End tiene al fin fecha de estreno |website=www.todotvnews.com |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20171201042710/http://www.todotvnews.com/news/La-adaptacin-espaola-de-The-End-tiene-al-fin-fecha-de-estreno.html |archive-date=2017-12-01}}</ref>

[[Mediapro]] and [[Medyapım]] established a Spanish-Turkish co-production company in 2022, focusing on making Spanish remakes of Turkish dramas.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://televizyongazetesi.com/kadin-kizim-ve-sadakatsiz-dizilerinin-ispanya-basarisi-medyapima-buyuk-bir-ortaklik-firsati-getirdi/1321621 | title=Kadın, Kızım ve Sadakatsiz dizilerinin İspanya başarısı, Medyapım'a büyük bir ortaklık fırsatı getirdi! | date=21 April 2022 }}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.medyatava.com/haber/medyapim-ispanyol-mediapro-ile-ortak-sirket-kurdu_254085 | title=Medyapım İspanyol Mediapro ile ortak şirket kurdu | newspaper=Medyatava | date=21 April 2022 | author1=Medyatava }}</ref>

''[[Sadakatsiz]]'' premiered with a powerful 18.1% rating on [[Antena 3 (Spanish TV channel)|Antena 3]] and 2,357,000 viewers, and it was the leader every Sunday and moved around a 14-15% share in Spain.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.superdeporte.es/ocio/tv/2022/02/08/infiel-llega-final-turquia-renueva-62448988.html | title='Infiel' llega a su final en Turquía: No renueva por una tercera temporada | newspaper=Superdeporte | date=8 February 2022 | last1=Yotele | first1=Redacción }}</ref> The final episode of ''Kızım'' (as {{lang|es|Mi hija}}) aired as the most-watched series on Antena 3 with an average of more than 2.4 million viewers and a 16.8% share,  also placing it as a leader on Sunday nights.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.diezminutos.es/teleprograma/series-tv/a37686034/mi-hija-final-serie-turca-antena-3-capitulos/ | title=El final de 'Mi hija' ya tiene fecha en Antena 3 | date=22 September 2021 }}</ref>

''Çilek Kokusu'' will be broadcast by Mediaset Spain's Divinity channel under the name ''Com olor a fresas''. The series will be broadcast every weekday.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/47868/1/cilek-kokusu-10-haziranda-ispanyadaki-yayinina-basliyor | title=Çilek Kokusu, 10 Haziran'da İspanya'daki yayınına başlıyor }}</ref> The same channel bought the broadcasting rights for Spain of Bu Şehir Arkandan Gelecek and Kaderimin Oyunu.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/47869/1/kaderimin-oyunu-ve-bu-sehir-arkandan-gelecek-yakinda-ispanyada-ekrana | title=Kaderimin Oyunu ve Bu Şehir Arkandan Gelecek yakında İspanya'da ekrana gelecek }}</ref>

====Italy====
''[[Kiraz Mevsimi|Cherry Season]]'' was the first Turkish TV series to be broadcast in Italy and received high ratings on Canale 5.<ref name="imnews.it"/> Turkish TV series such as ''Dolunay'' and ''Erkenci Kuş'' made [[Can Yaman]] an idol in Italy. Fan clubs were established for the duo of Can Yaman and Demet Özdemir. The actors of the Early Bird and Cherry Season series participated in talk shows in Italy.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KiChp3fenS0|title=Can Yaman: l'intervista in 100 secondi|date=15 October 2020 |via=www.youtube.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Mw1_Ogy2pTw|title=Demet Özdemir: l'intervista a Verissimo in 100 secondi|date=19 October 2020 |via=www.youtube.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=n5Pt2ters_M&list=PLhH5rB5NNJkv63sZp5GpJtUcy8TKQSHsz|title=Verissimo - I protagonisti di Cherry Season per la prima volta in Italia|date=3 October 2016 |via=www.youtube.com}}</ref> The series starring Kerem Bürsin and Hande Erçel on 'Canale 5' was broadcast under the name 'Love is in the Air'.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.cnnturk.com/yazarlar/guncel/reha-erus/balotelli-ile-uyum-saglamak-kolay-degil|title=Balotelli ile uyum sağlamak kolay değil|website=CNN Türk|date=24 August 2021 }}</ref>

The first episode of ''Sevgili Geçmiş'' was watched by 2 million 472 thousand people on Canale 5 with 13.4 per cent in primetime and took first place.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.medyafaresi.com/kose-yazisi/sevgili-gecmis-italyada-gonulleri-fethetti/944554|title = Sevgili Geçmiş İtalya'da gönülleri fethetti|date = 9 July 2020}}</ref>
Turkish TV series Brave & Beautiful met with the audience on 5 July in Italy on Canale 5.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.dizidoktoru.com/dizi/cesur-ve-guzel-italya-da-izleyiciyle-bulustu-h14400.html|title="Cesur ve Güzel" İtalya'da izleyiciyle buluştu|website=www.dizidoktoru.com}}</ref>

The broadcasting rights of ''Once Upon a Time in  Çukurova'' were purchased by Italian Mediaset.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/47863/1/bir-zamanlar-cukurova-italyada-da-izleyiciyle-bulusacak | title=Bir Zamanlar Çukurova, İtalya'da da izleyiciyle buluşacak! }}</ref> The drama aired as {{lang|it|Terra amara}} on Canale 5.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://mediasetinfinity.mediaset.it/article/mediasetinfinity/promo/terra-amara-serie-tv-turca-canale-5_SE000000000102_a34440?redirected=true|title = Terra Amara, la serie tv turca su Canale 5}}</ref> The stars of the drama participated in talk shows in Italy<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.superguidatv.it/ugur-gunes-a-verissimo-la-morte-di-yilmaz-in-terra-amara-video/|title=Ugur Gunes a Verissimo: la morte di Yilmaz in Terra Amara Video Mediaset|date =16 September 2023}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://mediasetinfinity.mediaset.it/video/verissimo/hilal-altinbilek-zuleyha-in-terra-amara_F312058301067C01|title =Hilal Altinbilek, Zuleyha in "Terra Amara"
}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://mediasetinfinity.mediaset.it/video/verissimo/murat-unalmis-demir-di-terra-amara_F312803001004C01|title =Murat Ünalmis, Demir di "Terra Amara"
}}</ref> and received awards at the 17th "Nations Awards-Thinking Green Taormina".<ref>{{cite web | url=https://todotvnews.com/en/inter-medyas-bitter-lands-wins-prestigious-award-in-italy/|title=Inter Medya's Bitter Lands Wins Prestigious Award in Italy|date =12 July 2023}}</ref> The prime-time broadcast of ''Once Upon a Time in Çukurova'' on Sunday, 14 January received higher ratings than a TV program in which Pope Francis appeared as a special guest.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.birsenaltuntas.com/dizi/bir-zamanlar-cukurova-dizisi-italyada-papa-ozel-yayinini-gecti/40109/|title ='"Bir Zamanlar Çukurova" dizisi İtalya'da Papa Özel yayınını geçti|date =20 February 2024}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.sabah.com.tr/yazarlar/gunaydin/aytug/2024/02/22/cukurova-papaya-tur-bindirdi|title ='Çukurova Papa'ya tur bindirdi}}</ref> The grand finale of ''Once Upon a Time in Çukurova'', which was broadcast under the name {{lang|it|Terra amara}}, received 18.2% in prime time and 19.83% in late-night hours on Saturday, 8 June.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.atv.com.tr/haberler/2024/06/13/bir-zamanlar-cukurova-final-bolumuyle-italyada-rekor-kirdi/|title ='Bir Zamanlar Çukurova' final bölümüyle İtalya'da rekor kırdı}}</ref>

====Russia====
[[File:AKALAY.jpg|thumb|[[Birce Akalay]] is the lead actress of ''[[Siyah Beyaz Aşk]]'']]
The first popular Turkish TV series in Russia was ''Çalıkuşu'', broadcast in 1986. ''[[Kurt Seyit ve Şura]]'' was broadcast on Russia's [[Domashny]] television channel in 2015. ''Muhteşem Yüzyıl'' was shown on Domashny in 2012 as {{lang|ru|Великолепный век}}. The series ''Kalbimin Sultanı'' (''Sultan of my Heart''), while not successful in Turkey, was broadcast on [[Channel One (Russia)|Channel One]], Russia's largest channel, in 2019, and it took the number one spot as the most-watched TV series in Russia.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://turkishtimedergi.com/genel/turk-dizisi-rusyayi-fethetti/|title=Türk dizisi, Rusya'yı fethetti!|accessdate=29 May 2023}}</ref> ''Siyah Beyaz Aşk'' was aired in Russia on the Domashniy channel.<ref>{{cite web|title=Черно-белая любовь|url=https://domashniy.ru/serials/cherno-belaya_lyubov/|website=domashniy.ru|date=29 August 2021}}</ref> ''Anne'', ''Kara Sevda'', ''Kara Para Aşk'' and ''Meryem'' aired in Russia as well.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gazeteoksijen.com/ekran/rusyada-kirmizi-beyaz-firtina-esmeye-basladi/|title = Rusya'da kırmızı-beyaz fırtına esmeye başladı|date = 3 September 2021}}</ref> ''Kara Sevda'' gained popularity in Russia. Russian viewers enjoyed watching not only the original episode, but also reruns of Kara Sevda.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://rusturkey.com/post/212986/chernaya-lyubov-za-kadrom-serial-fenomen-video|title = "Черная любовь" за кадром: сериал-феномен (ВИДЕО)| date=19 August 2021 }}</ref> Marina Hripunova, General Manager of the Russian Domashniy television channel, said, "We cannot do without Turkish TV series. Turkish TV series are watched with great interest in Russia."<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.dikgazete.com/ozel-haber/rus-tv-genel-muduru-turk-dizileri-olmadan-yapamayiz-fakat-yeni-h463333.html|title = Rus TV Genel Müdürü: Türk dizileri olmadan yapamayız, fakat yeni Türk dizleri de bekliyoruz}}</ref> Turkish star [[Tuba Büyüküstün]] became the face of Russian mobile operator, Megafon, in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://teammy.com/2021/08/03/24142/|title = Tuba Büyüküstün starred in the Russian commercial|date = 3 August 2021}}</ref>

A Russian remake of ''Paramparça'' aired in 2018 as Oskolki ({{lang|ru|Осколки}}) on WeIT Media.<ref>Archived at [https://ghostarchive.org/varchive/youtube/20211205/CSrYfVskS6o Ghostarchive]{{cbignore}} and the [https://web.archive.org/web/20200110115800/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CSrYfVskS6o Wayback Machine]{{cbignore}}: {{cite web| url = https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CSrYfVskS6o| title = Сериал "Осколки". 1 серия. 1 сезон | website=[[YouTube]]| date = 24 December 2019 }}{{cbignore}}</ref>

====Ukraine====
''Muhteşem Yüzyıl'' aired on Ukrainian [[Channel 1+1]] in 2012. === Latin America ===

Turkish dramas have become popular in [[Latin America]] after being dubbed into [[Spanish language|Spanish]] and [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]]. Due to the popularity, new Turkish shows continue to be dubbed into Spanish and Portuguese.<ref name=":122">{{Cite news|last=Tali|first=Didem|date=2016-09-08|title=Why do South Americans love Turkish TV?|language=en-GB|work=BBC News|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/business-37284938|access-date=2018-11-14}}</ref> In 2017, 25% of the biggest 7 Turkish exporting companies' business came from Latin America.<ref name=":022">{{cite web|title=Turkish Drama is expanding around the World. How? {{!}} Prensario Internacional|url=https://www.prensario.tv/novedades/1088-turkish-drama-is-expanding-around-the-world-how|access-date=2018-11-26|website=Prensario Internacional|language=es}}{{dead link|date=March 2026}}</ref>

The popularity of Turkish shows in Latin America has been credited to multiple factors. Burhan Gün, the president of the Turkish TV and Cinema Producers Guild, has stated that one reason is that Latin Americans and Turkish people can often look similar to each other.<ref name=":122"/> Gün has also expressed that Turkish shows portray storylines relating to migration patterns that are similar in many developing nations. Many shows portray plots about moving from rural areas to cities, and the challenges that come with this transition.<ref name=":122"/>

[[ATV (Turkish TV channel)|ATV]] has sold rights to air the series ''[[Hercai]]'' in various international markets, including most of Latin America and the United States through [[Telemundo]], which premiered on 22 June 2021.<ref>{{cite web|date=14 April 2021|title=Hercai Landing on Telemundo in the U.S. |url=https://worldscreen.com/tvdrama/hercai-landing-on-telemundo-in-the-u-s/|access-date=27 April 2021|website=worldscreen.com}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|date=17 May 2021|title=Hercai: Love and revenge premieres in June: Where?|url=https://www.explica.co/hercai-love-and-revenge-premieres-in-june-where.html|access-date=18 May 2021|archive-date=18 May 2021|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210518204636/https://www.explica.co/hercai-love-and-revenge-premieres-in-june-where.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> ''[[Exatlon|Exathlon]]'', a physical challenge [[reality TV|reality]] franchise created by Turkish company [[Acun Medya]] and first aired in Brazil, has inspired local versions of the show to be created in Latin America, such as ''Exatlón México'' in Mexico.<ref>{{cite web|last=@todotvnews|title=Spotlight On: Exathlon, the Ultimate Physical Challenge from Turkey to LatAm|url=http://www.todotvnews.com/news/Spotlight-On-Exathlon-Ultimate-Physical-Challenge-Turkey-LatAm-.html|access-date=2018-11-26|website=Todotvnews|language=en|archive-date=3 December 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181203104720/http://www.todotvnews.com/news/Spotlight-On-Exathlon-Ultimate-Physical-Challenge-Turkey-LatAm-.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

In 2020, [[Taner Ölmez]], the lead actor of ''[[Mucize Doktor]]'', won the "Best Foreign Actor" award at the Produ Awards, one of the most important awards of the television industry in Latin America.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/42712/1/taner-olmez-produ-awardsda-en-iyi-yabanci-erkek-oyuncu-odulunu-ald|title = Taner Ölmez, Produ Awards'da 'En İyi Yabancı Erkek Oyuncu' ödülünü aldı!| newspaper=Ranini.tv }}</ref> "[[Bir Zamanlar Çukurova]]" was announced as the "Best Foreign Series" and received one of the biggest awards at the Produ Awards. [[Vahide Perçin]] won the grand prize in the "Best Foreign Actress" category.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/42708/1/bir-zamanlar-cukurova-produ-awardsda-iki-odul-kazandi|title = Bir Zamanlar Çukurova, Produ Awards'da iki ödül kazandı!| newspaper=Ranini.tv }}</ref>{{better source needed|date=March 2026}}

HBO has launched a category for Turkish series on its digital platform in Latin America. To create this category, they signed a three-year agreement with Madd Entertainment, adding ten Turkish TV series to their catalogue. As of October 2021, ''Mucize Doktor'' was the most-watched series on HBO Max.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.medyatava.com/haber/mucize-doktor-mucizeler-yaratmaya-devam-ediyor-hbo-maxin-en-cok-izlenen-dizisi-oldu_229507|title = Mucize Doktor mucizeler yaratmaya devam ediyor! HBO Max'in en çok izlenen dizisi oldu|date = 21 October 2021}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Mucize Doktor’dan mucize reyting! Dizi, Şili’de yayınlandığı kanala birincilik getirdi!.. |url=https://televizyongazetesi.com/mucize-doktordan-mucize-reyting-dizi-silide-yayinlandigi-kanala-birincilik-getirdi/128571 |website=Televizyon Gazetesi |access-date=24 March 2026}}</ref> ''[[Sen Çal Kapımı]]'' ranked second in the Top 10 list on HBOMAXLA. It ranked first in Chile, Uruguay and Colombia, and third in Mexico and Argentina.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://televizyongazetesi.com/brezilyalilar-sirf-sen-cal-kapimi-izleyebilmek-icin-hbo-maxe-uye-oluyor/132186 | title=Brezilyalılar sırf Sen Çal Kapımı izleyebilmek için HBO Max'e üye oluyor! | date=April 2022 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://noticiasdatv.uol.com.br/noticia/novelas/animada-com-sucesso-hbo-max-estica-sen-cal-kapimi-ate-novembro-78757?cpid=txt | title=Animada com sucesso, HBO Max estica Sen Çal Kapimi até novembro | date=10 April 2022 }}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.turkishtvclub.com/sen-cal-kapimi-sera-isso-amor-the-most-watched-list-in-latin-america/ | title=Sen Cal Kapimi (Será Isso Amor?) the Most Watched List in Latin America! | date=26 March 2022 }}</ref>

==== Chile ====
In [[Chile]], the most watched Turkish show in 2014 was ''[[Binbir Gece]]''.<ref name=":122" /> According to a report by the German public broadcasting network [[ARD (broadcaster)|ARD]], [[Mega (Chilean TV network)|Mega]], the first Chilean channel to broadcast Turkish TV series, was saved from bankruptcy thanks to ''Binbir Gece''.<ref>{{cite web|last=BERLİN|first=Murat TOSUN|title='Binbir Gece', kanalı iflastan kurtardı|url=https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/avrupa/binbir-gece-kanali-iflastan-kurtardi-41773831|website=www.hurriyet.com.tr|date=28 March 2021 }}</ref> ''[[Sıla (TV series)|Sıla]]'' received ratings comparable to those for the [[Copa América]] qualifying match between Brazil and Chile.<ref>{{cite web|last=Varol|first=Ziyad|date=3 February 2016|title=The success story of Turkish TV series in Latin America|url=https://www.dailysabah.com/feature/2016/02/03/the-success-story-of-turkish-tv-series-in-latin-america|website=Daily Sabah}}</ref>

====Brazil====
''Binbir Gece'' was the first Turkish TV series to be broadcast in Brazil, where it aired on [[Rede Bandeirantes|TV Band]] in 2015.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.ntv.com.tr/sanat/bir-turk-dizisi-ilk-kez-brezilyada,oZFOcmd4BUWYv45QtxpOGA | title=Brezilya'da ilk kez bir Türk dizisi yayınlanacak }}</ref> Then ''Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne'' and ''Sıla'' aired.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://br.blastingnews.com/tv-famosos/2016/01/6-anos-depois-saiba-como-estao-os-atores-da-novela-turca-da-band-fatmagul-atualmente-00722975.html | title=6 anos depois: Saiba como estão os atores da novela turca da Band 'Fatmagul' atualmente | date=8 January 2016 }}{{dead link|date=March 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://br.blastingnews.com/tv-famosos/2016/09/as-novelas-turcas-de-mehmet-akif-alakurt-mais-esperadas-por-suas-fas-no-brasil-001122775.html | title=As novelas turcas de Mehmet Akif Alakurt mais esperadas por suas fãs no Brasil | date=20 September 2016 }}{{dead link|date=March 2026}}</ref> ''Sıla'' had the best first-week rating of Turkish soap operas on TV Band.<ref>{{cite news | url=https://natelinha.uol.com.br/novelas/2016/04/05/sila-tem-melhor-primeira-semana-de-novelas-turcas-na-band-98052.php | title="Sila" tem melhor primeira semana de novelas turcas na Band | website=NaTelinha at [[Universo Online]]}}</ref> [[HBO Brasil|HBO Max Brasil]] added the Turkish soap opera ''Sen Çal Kapımı'' to its Brazilian catalog, where it quickly became one of the most-watched shows.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://cinepop.com.br/sucesso-novela-vira-fenomeno-e-conquista-o-1o-lugar-entre-os-titulos-da-hbo-max-brasil-343725/ | title=SUCESSO! Novela vira fenômeno e conquista o 1º lugar entre os títulos da HBO Max Brasil &#124; CinePOP Cinema | date=6 May 2022 }}</ref>

====Colombia====

==== Argentina ====
In [[Argentina]], the show ''[[Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne?]]'' is extremely popular, with more than 12 million Argentine viewers watching each episode.<ref name=":122" /> ''Mucize Doktor'', which started broadcasting on Argentina's top channel [[Telefe]], received a rating of 14.2 in its first episode, making it the second-highest opening performance for a Turkish series. Two days later, on Wednesday, it reached the highest rating for a Turkish drama with a rating of 21.5.<ref>{{cite web|title=Arjantin'de 6 Türk dizisi yayınlanıyor; Mucize Doktor rekorla başladı!|url=https://t24.com.tr/haber/arjantin-de-6-turk-dizisi-yayinlaniyor-mucize-doktor-rekorla-basladi,948110|website=T24}}</ref>

==== Mexico ====
Adapted from the Turkish TV series ''[[Kara Para Aşk]]'', ''[[Imperio de mentiras]]'' was broadcast on a Mexican [[Televisa]] channel.<ref>{{cite web|title=Kara Para Aşk uyarlaması rekor kırdı!|url=https://www.dizidoktoru.com/dizi/kara-para-ask-uyarlamasi-rekor-kirdi-h4530.html|website=www.dizidoktoru.com}}</ref> The Mexican adaptation of ''[[Ezel (TV series)|Ezel]]'' was released in 2018 under the name ''Yago for Televisa''.<ref>{{cite web|title=Meksikalılar Ezel dizisini yeniden çekti: Yago - Sayfa 1|url=https://www.cnnturk.com/magazin/meksikalilar-ezel-dizisini-yeniden-cekti-yago|website=CNN Türk|date=7 April 2018 }}</ref> ''El Asesino Del Olvido'', the Mexican remake of the Turkish series ''[[Şahsiyet]]'', was aired.<ref>{{cite web|title=Şahsiyet'in Meksika uyarlaması: 'El Asesino Del Olvido'|url=https://www.esquire.com.tr/ekstra/kultur-sanat/2020/01/22/sahsiyetin-meksika-uyarlamasi-el-asesino-del-olvido|website=esquire}}</ref> A remake of ''[[Night Queen|Gecenin Kraliçesi]]'' was broadcast on Las Estrellas as  ''¿Te acuerdas de mí?'' in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ranini.tv/haber/43127/1/gecenin-kralicesi-dizisinin-meksika-uyarlamasi-18-ocakta-basliyor|title = Gecenin Kraliçesi dizisinin Meksika uyarlaması 18 Ocak'ta başlıyor}}</ref>

==== Hispanic community in the US ====
''[[Kara Sevda]]'', which aired on [[Univision]] in the United States, became the most-watched foreign soap opera in the country's history. It surpassed its main competitors in the Spanish-language market. It is also the most-watched Turkish series. The series averaged more than two million viewers per episode, with nearly four million tuning in for the finale.{{citation needed|date=March 2026}}

A Spanish-language American remake titled ''[[Pasión prohibida]]'' of ''Aşk-ı Memnu'' began airing in 2013.<ref>{{cite web|title=Aşk-ı Memnu Amerika'da|date=25 July 2012 |url=http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/kelebek/ask-i-memnu-amerikada-21062248|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190514041643/http://www.hurriyet.com.tr/kelebek/ask-i-memnu-amerikada-21062248|archive-date=14 May 2019|access-date=23 January 2020}}</ref>

''[[Sefirin Kızı]]'' made Univision the first U.S. network among Hispanic viewers in the weeknight 10 p.m. slot in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|last1=Vivarelli|first1=Nick|date=21 May 2021|title=Why Turkish Dramas Are Conquering Hispanic Audiences in the U.S. on Univision (EXCLUSIVE)|url=https://variety.com/2021/tv/news/turkish-dramas-u-s-hispanic-audiences-univision-1234978398/}}</ref>

===South Africa===
In late 2017, [[South Africa]]'s [[free-to-air]] channel [[e.tv]] closed a deal with Turkey's [[Kanal D]] to air various Kanal D dramas.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.c21media.net/news/south-africas-etv-takes-turkish-drama/|title=South Africa's ETV takes Turkish drama|work=C21 Media|last=Franks|first=Nico|date=30 October 2017}}</ref> These Turkish telenovelas were [[dubbing|dubbed]] into [[Afrikaans]] and proved to be highly successful for the channel, which led e.tv to launch a separate channel called ePlesier (''ePleasure'') as a new Afrikaans TV channel on its free-to-air satellite service [[OpenView HD]] on 18 April 2022. As a result, many more telenovelas were acquired, and the channel still operates as of 2023. The channel also provided a great amount of [[voice artist]] work for South African actors.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.news24.com/life/arts-and-entertainment/tv/etv-to-launch-new-channel-that-will-showcase-turkish-telenovelas-20220407-2|title=e.tv to launch new channel that will showcase Turkish telenovelas|last=Ferreira|first=Thinus|work=[[News24 (website)|News24]]|date=7 April 2022}}</ref> With the increasing popularity of Afrikaans-dubbed Turkish telenovelas, another South African channel, [[KykNet#Channels|KykNet&Kie]], also started broadcasting such telenovelas in July 2023. The channel acknowledged that "dubbing of such big series also creates dozens of job opportunities in the Afrikaans TV industry for talent behind the screens and in front of the microphone".<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.news24.com/life/arts-and-entertainment/tv/kyknet-adds-afrikaans-dubbed-turkish-telenovelas-20220515-3|title=kykNET adds Afrikaans-dubbed Turkish telenovelas|work=[[News24 (website)|News24]]|last=Ferreira|first=Thinus|date=15 May 2022}}</ref>

The Netflix drama ''[[Fatma (TV series)|Fatma]]'' was also adapted for South African Netflix as ''[[Unseen (TV series)|Unseen]]''.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://expatguideturkey.com/popular-turkish-netflix-series-adapted-to-south-africa/ | title=Popular Turkish Netflix Series Adapted to South Africa | date=30 March 2023 }}</ref>

===Elsewhere===

'''''Waris''''' ({{langx|ur|{{Nastaliq|وارث}}}}) is a Pakistani television drama serial created by [[Pakistan Television Corporation|PTV]], written by [[Amjad Islam Amjad]], and directed by Ghazanfer Ali and [[Nusrat Thakur]].<ref name=Dawn/><ref>{{cite news|url=https://tribune.com.pk/story/307611/pakistan-drama-industry-from-gold-to-ashes/?__cf_chl_jschl_tk__=47efc938a61397357f636f0c4a32f14084046b64-1580410539-0-AdY4_rCTmp9HzgOVlKjfZnmZdYwvO7jt9qtON7jbLoCqsvb-_fpx9aB713-XvpRiuyKbRbKowHq9lcDOXWIOhFtSNcGtXzbwXqOksal7C3xnEZ4F6zxtlOud9yfgQ2jg6Unz7NkhszjMcua5mZUU8J-MKb_H3mVMkOAI5cp4YxaL00D4R23pJetjrsoQ1Mv10CFWY23jp2RTDpvkMKHZQKuZDkMnEbM5vYRB-ibqTAwvs5ZCyf53SeUljhEdq1Cdbx_VMUrzOeRqmWwggA5OsNQ_XrxJbQNoVPyBzo2a0peczorAJ-ftSuWv8yW-JPNfO9XJuD3PGVzIi_awSB-2JHo |author=Hani Taha|date=16 December 2011|title=Pakistani drama industry: From gold to ashes|newspaper=The Express Tribune (newspaper)|access-date=30 January 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.pakistantribe.com/22165/pakistan-top-ten-best-t-v-directors |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161028023906/https://www.pakistantribe.com/22165/pakistan-top-ten-best-t-v-directors |url-status=usurped |archive-date=28 October 2016 |title=Pakistan Top Ten Best TV Directors|website=Pakistan Tribe website|date=11 November 2014|author=Saher Afshan|access-date=30 January 2020}}</ref>

The first of the 21 episodes was aired from PTV Lahore on Saturday 29 December 1979 and the last on 22 March 1980 and was an acclaimed mega hit.<ref>{{cite news |title=ڈراما سیریل 'وارث' 40 برس بعد بھی لوگوں کو کیوں یاد ہے؟ |url=https://www.urduvoa.com/a/classic-drama-serial-waris-still-popular-12jun2020/5460182.html |work=Voice of America (Urdu) |date=19 June 2020}}</ref><ref name=Dawn>{{cite news|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/1169324 |title=Old but not forgotten: Top 10 Pakistani dramas to re-watch now|newspaper=Dawn (newspaper)|author=Bisma Ahmad|date=13 March 2015|access-date=30 January 2020}}</ref>
https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLj-INzURwZ47eoyu03xgsEN2McrtfB8VZ&si=wDHnayONP3vt6ZKO

==Plot==
A Punjabi feudal (''[[zamindar]]''), Chaudhry<ref group=note>The name '' Chaudhary  '' also means a feudal lord.</ref> Hashmat rules his fiefdom, Sikandarpur, with an iron grip. Along with his son Chaudhry Yaqub and two grandsons Chaudhry Anwar Ali and Chaudhry Niaz Ali (sons of his deceased son, Chaudhry Ghulam Ali), he struggles to hold on to Sikanderpur, which is the proposed site for a dam.

The two grandsons are constantly at loggerheads. The younger one, Chaudhry Anwar Ali is a prodigal scion of a feudal family. He is also ruthless, like his grandfather, Chaudhry Hashmat. The older one, Chaudhry Niaz Ali wishes to escape to the big city, Lahore, but is trapped in the feudal web.

There is vicious intra-family feudal politics at play. Chaudhry Yaqub is eyeing the entire estate of his father Chaudhry Hashmat by attempting to pit Chaudhry Anwar against his older brother Chaudhry Niaz. His machinations are carried out by Mauladad, who is an employee of Chaudhry Anwar. Mauladad is a tough, wily guy employed by Chaudhry Anwar to carry out hit-jobs, abductions, etc.

Fateh Sher is an unknown guy, his true identity is revealed as the drama reaches its climax. Fateh Sher fled to Sikandarpur with his wife Zohra. Zohra was originally engaged to the older nephew of the Chaudhry of Ahmadpur, Hayat Muhammad. Another lead character, Dilawar is the younger nephew of Hayat Muhammad. Zohra's marriage with Fateh Sher causes strife in the village and they had to run for their lives. After moving to Sikandarpur, they start a new life and Fateh Sher assumes a new identity.

Meanwhile, a blood feud ensues between the families of Hayat Muhammad and Fateh Sher. In rural Punjabi culture, it is a huge insult for a man, if his fiancé marries someone else. To avenge this grave insult, Dilawar's older brother launches a failed attack on Fetah Sher's village, where police were lying in wait in anticipation of an attack. To save his older brother, Dilawar gives a false statement to the police saying he launched the attack and not his brother. For this (false) acknowledgement, Dilawar is sentenced to ten years in prison. While Dilawar is serving his term, his older brother goes out to seek and kill Fateh Sher. But before he can get to Fateh Sher, Fateh Sher kills him. These events catalyze a deep rage and hatred in Dilawar against Fateh Sher. Upon his release from prison, he only has one purpose in life - to seek out and kill Fateh Sher.

Fateh Sher was last spotted in Sikandarpur, the fiefdom of Chaudhry Hashmat. It is very difficult for any outsider to come to Sikandarpur without attracting the scrutiny of Chaudhry Hashmat and his servants. To get to Sikandarpur, Dilawar starts working as a servant for Chaudhry Yaqub in Lahore. When Chaudhry Hashmat visits his son Chaudhry Yaqub in Lahore to purchase a high-pedigree dog (Crystal) from Saulat Mirza, the latter turns down all offers, infuriating Chaudhry Hashmat who is not used to taking no for an answer. Seizing the opportunity to earn Chaudhry Hashmat's favor, Dilawar steals the prized dog, Crystal, from Saulat Mirza and brings it to Chaudhry Hashmat. This act endears Dilawar to Chaudhry Hashmat and lets Dilawar into Chaudhry Hashmat's inner circle of confidants and servants. Chaudhry Hashmat takes Dilawar with him to Sikandarpur.

Ironically, the first and only true friend Dilawar makes in Sikandarpur is Mauladad, who in reality is his nemesis Fateh Sher - the person Dilawar is seeking to find and kill.

'''''Zara Yaad Kar''''' ({{langx|ur|{{Nastaliq|ذرا یاد کر}}|{{translation|Do just remember}}}}) is a 2016 Pakistani [[TV serial|drama serial]] that aired on [[Hum TV]] from 15 March 2016 to 20 September 2016. It was directed and produced by Amna Nawaz Khan and written by [[Khalil-ur-Rehman Qamar]]. It starred [[Zahid Ahmed (actor)|Zahid Ahmed]], [[Yumna Zaidi]] and [[Sana Javed]].<ref>{{cite web |last1=Faisal |first1=Sabeen |title=Zahid Ahmed talks about upcoming play 'Zara Yaad Kar' |url=http://www.hipinpakistan.com/news/1148288 |work=Ahmed Hussain |publisher=HIP |date=3 February 2016 |access-date=3 February 2016 |archive-date=26 January 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160126083245/http://www.hipinpakistan.com/news/1148288 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Zahid Ahmed Will Play A Positive Role In "Zara Yaad Kar" |url=http://arydigital.pk/zahid-ahmed-will-play-a-positive-role-in-zara-yaad-kar/ |work=Saud |publisher=ARY Digital |date=7 November 2015 |access-date=3 February 2016 |archive-date=15 February 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160215232538/http://arydigital.pk/zahid-ahmed-will-play-a-positive-role-in-zara-yaad-kar/ |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url=http://tiptoptime.com/a-quick-review-on-drama-serial-zara-yaad-kar/ |title=A Quick Review on Drama Serial Zara Yaad Kar – TipTopTime |date=1 August 2016 |work=TipTopTime |access-date=13 June 2018 |language=en-US |archive-date=13 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180613085448/http://tiptoptime.com/a-quick-review-on-drama-serial-zara-yaad-kar/ |url-status=live }}</ref> The plot revolves around a dedicated woman who is in love with a middle-class yet sincere man but he is married with a carefree carper.

It marked the second on-screen pairing of Yumna and Zahid after their appearance in ''[[Jugnoo (TV series)|Jugnoo]]'' (2015). Zaidi's performance was lauded by audiences and critics.

== Plot ==
{{long plot|date=April 2023}}
The story revolves around Hadi and Mahnoor, who are first cousins and married (Nikkah). Hadi is a simple man, with a limited earning but he earnestly loves Mahnoor. He lives in a rented room in a house owned by Ikhtiar Ali. Ikhtiar and his college-going daughter Uzma both hold Hadi in high regard due to his impeccable character and calm demeanor. Hadi is immensely caring and protective towards Mahnoor, whom he treats as the center of his universe. He is also broad-minded and encourages Mahnoor to work and be self-sufficient. Uzma, who is unaware that Hadi is married, is drawn to him due to his likeable nature. She ends up writing a letter to Hadi confessing her crush on him. Hadi gently rebukes her, letting her know that he is married and deeply in love with Mahnoor. He shows the letter to Mahnoor thinking that he should not hide anything from his wife.

Mahnoor on the other hand is not as emotionally invested in the relationship as Hadi. Her selfish side emerges when she meets her new neighbour Waqar who teaches Urdu in a local college. Mahnoor finds Waqar wealthier and more attractive than Hadi. Her greed leads to her asking Hadi for divorce so that she can marry Waqar. Her selfish act creates a rift between her and her mother Aneesa ([[Saba Faisal (actress)|Saba Faisal]]) and leaves Hadi heart-broken. Although deeply hurt, Hadi agrees to divorce Mahnoor as he believes Mahnoor's feelings for Waqar to be genuine. He agrees to the divorce in order to preserve his own self-respect and also because he believes in letting go someone who doesn't love him.

Mahnoor asks Waqar to marry her on the same day that she gets divorce from Hadi, to which Waqar tacitly agrees. However, unbeknownst to Mahnoor, Waqar is an opportunist and has interest in women only for their wealth. He is hired to teach Urdu to Geeti ([[Shermeen Ali]]), who is the daughter of a renowned politician Deswali (Adnan Jilani). Geeti has recently returned from USA to contest upcoming elections from the town to which Waqar belongs. Waqar leaves for his hometown without informing Mahnoor, with his house help Umerdeen in his tow.

While learning Urdu from Waqar, Geeti starts to get attracted to him. He accompanies her on her campaign tours, which allows them to spend more and more time together, strengthening her feeling for him. Eventually, Geeti confesses her feelings to Waqar, who feels elated to have won the heart of a powerful politician's daughter. Aneesa, concerned about the future of her daughter, manages to find Waqar's whereabouts and hands them over to Mahnoor so that she can find out his plans. Mahnoor, ecstatic at finally having received Waqar's whereabouts, calls him. Waqar acts innocent about his sudden departure, hints at being in some sort of trouble and promises to meet Mahnoor after a couple of months after he has had the chance to settle the matters he is involved with.

Waqar's response makes Mahnoor suspicious and she seemingly grows repentant for her behaviour towards Hadi. She tries to apologize to Hadi without her mother's knowledge in order to move towards a possible reconciliation. However, Hadi does not forgive her immediately, still nursing his hurt self-respect. Mahnoor grows desperate and asks Hadi to remarry her, in blatant disregard of religious and social norms. Mahnoor's act leaves Hadi even more heart-broken because he sees Mahnoor taking marriage, commitment, love and relationships so lightly. He starts to wonder whether he is ready to suffer another heart-break by remarrying Mahnoor, despite still loving her to his core.

Waqar's soaring dreams come crashing down when Geeti's brother discovers his schemes. Waqar gets beaten up, is warned to stay away from Geeti, gets threatened to marry immediately and leave the city. Helpless against the might of Geeti's brother, Waqar leaves the city as advised. Feeling cheated by Waqar, Mahnoor decides to get back with Hadi at all costs. However, she can do so only by marrying another man, divorcing him and waiting for a mandatory period before remarrying Hadi. Jealous of Uzma who she fears may take Hadi away from her, she asks Hadi to leave Uzma's house and find another accommodation. Uzma too asks Hadi to leave after she is accused by Mahnoor of trying to win over Hadi.

A helpless Hadi leaves Uzma's house and takes up accommodation in another house, owned by (Fauzia Mushtaq). There he meets Anushay, her grand-daughter. Hadi learns that Anushay is the new girlfriend of Waqar and unaware of Waqar's past, she is looking forward to marry him. Hadi tries to stop her by sharing Waqar's past deeds with her and her grandmother; but stubborn by nature, Anushay isn't willing to give up on Waqar and ends up marrying him.

Geeti's brother gets arrested for a road accident and she learns that her father and brother have planted false evidence and witnesses to take the blame away from her brother. Disgusted, she decides to leave the country and go back to US but tracks down Waqar for one final meeting to thank him for introducing her to the world of deceit. This triggers a change of heart in Waqar who decides to lead a life of honesty and decency with Anushay. However, as fate would have it, Anushay gets murdered at their home and all evidence points towards Waqar, who gets sent to prison for his life.

Hadi comes across Umerdeen and convinces him to marry Mahnoor for one day so that he and Mahnoor can get married. Umerdeen agrees to this and a relieved Hadi breaks this news to Mahnoor. However, he ends up overhearing Mahnoor telling her mother that she is marrying Hadi only out of pity. She further goes on to say that she finds Hadi's company unbearable and that she would treat her impending marriage to him as a prison for life. A disgusted Hadi finally wakes up to Mahnoor's true nature and regrets his selfless devotion to her.

Mahnoor marries Umerdeen, thinking that he would divorce her the next day, only to find out to her shock that Umerdeen has no such intentions. He hands out a letter to her before taking her with him to his hometown. The letter has been written by Hadi who rebukes her for her selfishness and lack of respect for others. He also expresses his disappointment over Mahnoor's lack of acknowledgement for his love and care. He reveals his heartbreak to her after overhearing her conversation with her mother where she compared the prospects a life with Hadi to a lifelong prison sentence. He further writes that it was he who effected the change of plans with Umerdeen, even though he had to resort to deceit to do so, going against his nature and principles.

Uzma too is in for a shock as she discovers Hadi at her doorstep, finally acknowledging her love for him and asking her to marry him, to which she agrees.

== Release ==
=== Home media and streaming service ===
The show was uploaded on Hum TV's official [[YouTube]] channel simultaneously with its airing on TV. Later in 2017, all the episodes were deleted and reuploaded in October 2019 with muted music. It is also available on [[Eros Now]].

'''&TV''', also known as '''And TV''', is a [[Hindi]]-language entertainment channel owned by [[Zee Entertainment Enterprises]] (ZEEL). Launched as a general entertainment channel from ZEEL group, it started broadcasting on 2 March 2015 with internationally in Middle East.<ref name=launch>[http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/tv/news/hindi/ZEE-Entertainment-launches-new-Hindi-General-Entertainment-Channel-TV/articleshow/45974989.cms ZEE Entertainment launches new Hindi General Entertainment Channel '&TV']. [[Times of India]]. 22 January 2015.</ref> On 6 April 2015, &TV launched in UK replacing Lamhe. On 1 June 2019, &TV was closed in the UK due to the launch of [[ZEE5]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.india.com/lifestyle/its-destination-zee5-zing-tv-and-living-foodz-to-be-available-as-digital-only-channels-on-zee5-in-uk-3658503/|title=Its Destination ZEE5: Zing, &TV, and Living Foodz to be Available as Digital-Only Channels on ZEE5 in UK {{pipe}} India.com|website=India.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=And TV: Top Stories On Latest And TV Hindi Serials & Shows, Hindi Movie Reviews, Gossip And News Updates {{!}} ZEE5 |url=https://andtv.zee5.com/ |access-date=2023-08-07 |website=&TV |language=en |archive-date=5 October 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231005232635/https://andtv.zee5.com/ |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Watch &TV HD Live Online in HD |url=https://www.zee5.com/tv-shows/andtv-hd/0-9-tvhd_0 |access-date=2023-08-07 |website=ZEE5 |language=en-IN}}</ref> On 11 November 2024, &TV relaunched in the UK on [[Samsung TV Plus]] and [[Rakuten TV|Rakuten tv]] on 10 March 2025.

'''''ARY Digital HD''''' ({{langx|ur|{{Nastaliq|ARY ڈیجیٹل}}}}) is a Pakistani television network available in [[Pakistan]]. ARY Digital was founded by a [[Dubai]]-based holding company of Pakistani businessman, [[Abdul Razzak Yaqoob]] and [[Salman Iqbal]] (ARY). The network is focused towards on Pakistani entertainment dramas, sitcoms, talk shows, web series and culture.

The channel broadcasts on cable and satellite networks, [[Linear TV|linear television]] as well as streaming platforms including [[YouTube]] Channel and [https://aryplus.tv ARY Plus].

==History==
ARY Digital, formerly known as '''The Pakistani Channel''', was launched in the United Kingdom on 16th September 2000 to cater to the Pakistani community living in the region.{{Citation needed|date=November 2015}} It uses Samacom, an uplink provider based in the UAE, as the uplink teleport station.<ref name="CITEREFSamacom1">{{cite web|url=http://www.samacom.com/teleport.htm|title=Teleport|publisher=Samacom|access-date=2008-05-11| archive-url= https://web.archive.org/web/20080506164425/http://www.samacom.com/teleport.htm| archive-date= 6 May 2008 | url-status= live}}</ref> The channel started off with a format similar to [[Pakistan Television|PTV Prime]] and other South Asian channels where it provided slots for soap operas in general while presenting an hourly slot for news headlines. Although flaming political talk shows and dramas were the main priority when it came to programming, the network soon was hailed for its news coverage.<ref name="CITEREFPakAffairs1">{{cite web|url=http://www.pakaffairs.com/?p=5|title=Case Study: Pakistan and its Media|publisher=PakAffairs.com|access-date=2008-05-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080403182838/http://www.pakaffairs.com/?p=5|archive-date=3 April 2008|url-status=dead}}</ref>

The network acquired a license to start broadcasting in Pakistan.<ref name="CITEREFARYGroup1">{{cite web|url=http://www.arydigitaleurope.tv/ary_group_profile.pdf|title=ARY Group Profile|publisher=ARY Digital Europe|access-date=2008-05-11 |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20080528142043/http://www.arydigitaleurope.tv/ary_group_profile.pdf |archive-date = 2008-05-28}}</ref>

In 2002, the ARY Star Gold Quiz Show became the first live show to offer a prize of one kilogram of gold. For the period of its broadcast, participants won over 260 kilograms of gold.<ref name="CITEREFARYGroup1"/>

[[File:ARY Digital Logo 1.PNG|thumb|former logo (2000–2009)|right|120px]]

==Specialized programming==
By 2003, ARY Digital had started up three sister ventures apart from the flagship channel ARY Digital, channels targeting generalized programming. They include [[ARY News]], a news channel; [[ARY Musik]], a youth-oriented music channel, and [[ARY Qtv]], an Islamic network.<ref name="CITEREFARYDigitalTower1">
{{cite web|url=http://dramaaz.com/ary-digital/|title=ARY Digital Archives|publisher=ARY Digital|access-date=8 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151225093926/http://dramaaz.com/ary-digital/|archive-date=25 December 2015|url-status=usurped|df=dmy-all}}
</ref>

== Programming ==
{{main|List of programs broadcast by ARY Digital}}

==Criticism==
In 2003, ARY Digital was criticised upon its airing of a prisoner's derogatory comments against the Anti-Terrorism Court (ATC-3) and a video showing balded young girls behind bars begging for mercy. The contempt of court proceedings against the officials of the network were withdrawn after the judge accepted unconditional apologies.<ref name="CITEREFARYDawn1">{{cite web|url=https://www.dawn.com/news/114927/karachi-contempt-proceedings-withdrawn-against-ary|title=KARACHI: Contempt proceedings withdrawn against ARY|publisher=[[Dawn (newspaper)|DAWN Newspaper]]|access-date=2008-05-12}}</ref>

'''ATV''' was a Pakistani general entertainment TV channel which aired acquired serials from other channels like [[A-Plus TV|A Plus]], [[PTV Home]] and [[Hum TV]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=29 January 2013 |title=The New Age of Pakistan's TV Drama - Syed Abbas Hussain - Youlin Magazine |url=https://www.youlinmagazine.com/story/the-new-age-of-pakistan-tv-drama/ODM= |access-date=2026-03-15 |website=Youlin Magazine |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Agency |first=Anadolu |date=2021-04-06 |title=Turkish serial ‘The Ottoman’ to air in Pakistan soon |url=https://www.dailysabah.com/arts/cinema/turkish-serial-the-ottoman-to-air-in-pakistan-soon |access-date=2026-03-15 |website=Daily Sabah |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=ATV added new territories for The Ottoman |url=https://www.prensario.net/ATV-added-new-territories-for-emThe-Ottomanem-34559.note.aspx |access-date=2026-03-15 |website=www.prensario.net |language=es}}</ref> It also showed children's programs as well as talk shows and a morning show. It was closed on 19 June 2026 due to financial reasons.

==Channel profile==
The channel originally started as People's Television Network (PTN) in 1990 as the first semi-governmental TV Channel and second TV Channel of Pakistan from Islamabad. In 1991 PTN's name was changed to [[Shalimar Television Network]] (STN). STN came under PTV Network and was relaunched as Channel-3 in 1999 and with that the channel made its way to the satellite as well. In 2005 name of the channel was changed to ATV as it was relaunched this time under a joint venture of Shalimar Recording and Broadcasting Company (SRBC). Since 2018 ATV was being operated under Shalimar TV Network of SRBC. ATV now operates with 20 stations covering all major cities and commercial centres of Pakistan.{{CN|date=February 2025}}

Atv closed on 19 June 2026 due to non payment of salaries to its employees and financial problems.

'''''Aangan''''' ({{langx|ur|{{nq|آنگن}}|lit=Courtyard}}) is a Pakistani family drama television series that premiered on 18 November 2017 on [[ARY Digital]] and ended on 12 July 2018. The series was aired as part of the channel's night prime time slot programming.It was written by [[Faiza Iftikhar]], directed by Qasim Ali Mureed and created by [[Humayun Saeed]] and Shahzad Nasib under [[Six Sigma Plus]].<ref name="shdi"/><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.hipinpakistan.com/news/1154277|title=In Review: With a wedding about to happen Aangan has become a must watch!|last=Khan|first=Saira|date=2018-01-16|work=HIP|access-date=2018-07-19|language=en-US}}</ref>

''Aangan'' has an ensemble cast with [[Mansha Pasha]], [[Qavi Khan]], [[Samina Ahmad]], [[Irsa Ghazal]], [[Hassan Ahmed (actor)|Hassan Ahmed]], [[Iffat Rahim]], [[Zainab Qayyum]], [[Waseem Abbas]], [[Paras Masroor]] and [[Uzma Hassan]] in ensemble pivotal roles. It received three nominations at 18th [[Lux Style Awards]].{{citation needed|date=November 2022}}

== Plot ==

Aangan is the story of a joint Punjabi family headed by Mian ji who lives with his wife, Zaitoon Bano, his three sons with their families and an unmarried daughter, Zoya, he has another son staying abroad and another married daughter. They are worried about Zoya's marriage. Zoya's eldest sister in law, Hajira, invites her friend's son, Aqdus, to come live with them for some time as he lives abroad and is looking for an apartment. He falls in love with Zoya and asks his mom to come and ask for her hand in marriage. His mom though reluctant (as Zoya is older than Aqdus) asks for her son's marriage with Zoya, which leaves the family shocked as they had expected him to marry Shaina, Hajira's daughter.

Hajira's son, Sadaan is in love with Afra but cannot marry her as Hajira is against the marriage and wants Shaina to get married first. The second daughter in law, Laila has no child and often gets taunted for the same, however her husband, Asim loves her dearly. The third daughter in law, Rubeena is pregnant with her fourth child. Her husband, Zahid is a moulvi but he does nothing to support her kids or wife who are being looked after by his brothers. After Zoya marries Aqdus, the family is happy, but their happiness is cut-short as they find out that Asim has another wife Haseena. Also, Sadaan secretly marries Afra with the blessings of Asim, Zahid and his father Sajjad on his side.

Later Shafiq, the second son who lives in Germany, returns to Pakistan for his share of property so that he can use that money for his son Waleed's marriage. He tells everyone to sell the house and the factory, take their shares and live separately. Anila, the first daughter of the family and the troublemaker, is in favor of Shafiq, as she plans to marry off one of her daughters to Shafiq's son. But later, finds out that Shafiq had already arranged the marriage of his son with a rich businessman's daughter in Pakistan. Hence, it's decided by Mian Ji and the whole family that they would sell off the house and factory and distribute the property shares equally. Meanwhile, Sajjad, the eldest son's health has been deteriorating due to the recent happenings. And due to all those tractions, Sajjad dies of heart failure.

This shocks the whole family, while leaving Anila and Shafiq in guilt of being the cause of their brother's death. They decide to give up their shares in the assets. At last, Shafiq announces to everyone that he is giving up his property at his own will and leaves for Germany. A few months later, with everything back to normal, Zahid and Sadaan now run the factory and Haseena is now treated equally as Laila. The story ends with a good news that Afra, Sadaan's wife is pregnant with a baby girl.
